# Lab · Zero Energy

Isolated copy of the **frozen** Zero Energy clone for ClickMotion / MS.

**Do not edit** `E:\website-tests\zero-energy-clone`. That tree is the official freeze.

**Do not fork** `CanGallery`. Hub `/` + lab `/lab/can-gallery` share the same module. `/home` redirects to the lab on purpose.

## Run

```text
cd Lab/zero-energy/app
npm install
npm run dev
```

Port **3070**. Three **0.161.0** exact.
